name: Sarah Catherine Hook
biography: Sarah Catherine Hook is an American actress and singer. Born and raised in Montgomery, AL, she went on to SUNY Purchase College to pursue a degree in Vocal Performance: Opera where she received her Bachelor of Music. During her time at Purchase, she began to pique her interest in acting and attended the Atlantic Theater Company Summer Intensive. Since then, she has continued to take both acting and singing courses around New York. Sarah Catherine is known for The Conjuring 3, Law & Order: SVU, and Living in Harmony Sodastream.
movies: The Conjuring: The Devil Made Me Do It
